items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Bradley took him side, stepped from him and cracked him and down he went.

ctx.x: Now, the fellas used to shoot dice with candlelight, you know. And the police would slip upon them. Well, they broke and run, they'd break and run and all go. Some of them had that, had a, what's a couple of basins, that was a new basin out there. It was off, it wasn't filled in like it is now. But they'd run all around that new basin, they had a lumber yard back there, they'd get around that lumber yard. They'd run all around them different hours back there and behind that lumber, they couldn't find him. Well,…
Did you know Rabbit that played guitar?
